newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia May inflation seen rising 0.18-0.20 pct.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia May inflation seen rising 0.18-0.20 pct.

text.p: Indonesia's consumer price index for May was likely to show a month-on-month rise of 0.18-0.20 percent, compared with 0.56 percent in April, banking sources said on Monday.
The official inflation figure will be announced on Wednesday after the regular monthly cabinet meeting.
Indonesia posted an inflation rate of 6.47 percent for the 1996 calendar year against 8.64 percent in 1995.
The government has forecast an inflation rate of six percent for the 1997/98 fiscal year starting on April 1.
